# Living dispersal for the BOB2 Modern Fix.
# 28 RAF fields, 540 objects, static only.

# 300 m from each reference point at the bearing that best clears the
# runway and whatever is already there. Written by
# dev/build_raf_dispersal.py; edit the script, not this file.
# Delete this file to remove every one of them.
